description: Change the state of a home device: turn lights, fans or locks on or off, dim lights, set the thermostat. Changes things in the house.
examples: Set the living room lights to 40 percent
Turn the bedroom fan to low
Make the bedroom lights warm white
Turn up the heat a couple of degrees
Turn on the fan in the nursery
negatives: Play some jazz in the kitchen
Create an automation that turns off the lights at midnight
